notice: The native prototype is local-only and does not call these routes automatically. Live account, AI, analytics and billing services fail closed. This replaces the abandoned pantry contract.

checkIn.routines: Unique array of nutrition, movement and/or reflection; empty permitted
checkIn.note: String up to 500 characters; empty permitted

milestone.title: Nonblank string up to 80 characters
milestone.note: String up to 300 characters; empty permitted

routes.other: 503 setup_required outside the explicitly enabled loopback demo

routes.behavior: Local D1 upserts by calendar day and preserves the existing entry ID. Node preview returns stored:false; clients must not show cloud-save success.

request.checkIns: 0–7 unique daily checkIns within that seven-day interval

response.title: string
response.body: Deterministic factual counts, not medical or AI advice

routes.privacy: No notes, weight, appetite, email, free text or health values. No live ingestion.

routes.status: Disabled by default. Requires configured consent/privacy text, D1 and verified Turnstile; no false success.
